payload.summary: Synergy CHC Corp., review date Aug 13, 2024; request is a $250,000, 6-month advance, analytical fixture. Two supplier-settlement loans had 2024 amounts outstanding at June 30, 2024. (1) The Dec 28, 2023 former-supplier settlement loan: $2.0M scheduled for 2024 (eff_003). Linking it to the Atrium/HVL settlement is an INFERENCE from the matching $5.45M amount, the December 2023 date and the Note 13 cross-reference. (2) The VitBest settlement: $600k scheduled for 2024 (eff_004). The LODC and Valenti settlements are already paid (eff_007). $100k of restricted cash is held as credit card collateral (eff_010). Knight's terms bar adding other debt without first paying out Knight, and a third-party debt default automatically defaults the Knight loan (eff_009). Knight also requires Shopify debt to be repaid by Dec 31, 2024 (eff_012). Sensitivity against ~$2.0M reported cash and the $200k illustrative reserve gives a necessary net cash need of: $800k if none of the 2024 settlement amounts has been paid since June 30; $900k if $100k of the reported cash is unavailable; $150k–$250k at 25% paid; $0 at 50% paid.

payload.conclusion: No funding conclusion can be reached. Under the Knight loan terms, Synergy shall not add any other debt without paying out Knight first, and a default on third-party debt automatically defaults the Knight loan. So any new advance depends on Knight's consent, which the evidence does not establish. Separately, the scheduled 2024 settlement payments are $2.0M on the December 28, 2023 former-supplier settlement loan (identified as the Atrium settlement by inference) and $600k on the VitBest settlement, both measured at June 30, 2024. Shopify debt must also be repaid by December 31, 2024. Against about $2.0M of reported cash and the illustrative $200k reserve, the sensitivity shows a necessary net cash need of $800k if nothing has been paid since June 30, $900k if $100k of cash is unavailable, and $0 once half has been paid. The cash requirement therefore turns on payments made since June 30, and feasibility turns on Knight's consent. The LODC and Valenti settlements are already paid and add no future cash outflow.
